gloss: to breed; to raise; to keep (animals)

definitions.gloss: to breed; to raise; to keep (animals)
definitions.explanation: To care for and raise animals, whether domesticated pets or livestock.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{動物園|どうぶつえん}→動物園：01686_doubutsuen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{希少|きしょう}→希少：12444_kishou⟧な⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飼育|しいく}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

examples.english: Raising cattle requires ample land and sufficient feed.

notes:
A somewhat formal word for raising or keeping animals. It implies ongoing care and management, and is used more broadly than ⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧, which is the everyday word for keeping a pet. {飼育|しいく}する is preferred in professional, institutional, and scientific contexts such as zoos, farms, and research facilities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飼育|しいく}する: to raise animals
- ⟦{家畜|かちく}→家畜：06431_kachiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飼育|しいく}する: to raise livestock
- ⟦{飼育|しいく}→飼育：06422_shiiku⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧: breeding environment
- ⟦{飼育|しいく}{員|いん}→飼育員：17861_shiikuin⟧: animal caretaker, zookeeper
- ⟦{飼育|しいく}→飼育：06422_shiiku⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: rearing method

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧: to keep (a pet) — the everyday, casual word for having a pet at home
- ⟦{養殖|ようしょく}→養殖：08648_youshoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to farm; to cultivate — used for aquaculture (fish, shellfish, seaweed)
- ⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise; to bring up — a general word that applies to children, plants, and animals alike
